sources.title: Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509 model card
sources.evidence: Exact 2509 instruction-tuned checkpoint, based on Apertus-70B-2509. Card reports 70B nominal scale, 15T pretraining tokens, xIELU decoder-only Transformer, 65,536-token context, tool-use support, and Apache-2.0 open weights.

sources.title: Apertus: a fully open, transparent, multilingual language model
sources.evidence: Dated 2 September 2025 announcement states EPFL, ETH Zurich and CSCS released Apertus that day, in 8B and 70B sizes, with models then downloadable from Hugging Face.

sources.title: Apertus v1 Technical Report, revised 1 December 2025
sources.evidence: Section 2.1 explicitly identifies dense decoder-only Transformers; the 70B model has 80 layers, width 8192, 64 query heads and 8 KV heads. The report identifies text-only modalities and describes tool-oriented instruction training.

sources.title: Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509 pinned model configuration
sources.evidence: ApertusForCausalLM; 80 layers, hidden width 8192, FFN width 43008, vocabulary 131072, 64 query/8 KV heads, 65,536 positions, xIELU, BF16 and untied embeddings. No quantization configuration.

sources.title: Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509 pinned weight index and indexed tensor headers
sources.evidence: The earlier complete audit matched all 30 shard headers to 1,123 indexed tensors: 70,599,864,640 stored BF16 elements, excluding 160 beta/eps buffers to obtain 70,599,864,480 learned parameters. The fresh pinned index still explicitly reports total_parameters=70599864480; a fresh configured-module calculation independently agrees. No weight shards were requested in this re-audit.

sources.title: Transformers v4.56.0 Apertus model implementation
sources.evidence: Implementation recommended by the model card defines embeddings, 80 configured decoder blocks, attention/MLP/norm modules and output head. Every checkpoint tensor name and shape matches these modules; no expert or multi-token-prediction modules exist.

sources.title: Transformers v4.56.0 xIELU activation implementation
sources.evidence: XIELUActivation defines alpha_p and alpha_n as learned scalar Parameters, while beta and eps are registered buffers. ACT2FN instantiates a fresh activation for each MLP, so 160 learned alpha scalars are distinct and 160 buffer scalars are excluded.

sources.title: Transformers v4.56.0 embedding tying implementation
sources.evidence: Input/output embedding tying is conditional on tie_word_embeddings, which is false in this checkpoint; both separately stored matrices count as parameters.

sources.title: Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509 Apache license
sources.evidence: The distributed license is Apache License 2.0, with copyright attributed to the Swiss AI team.

sources.title: Are thoughts generated by released Instruct checkpoints?
sources.evidence: Responding about the released 8B/70B Instruct checkpoints, Swiss AI organization member loleg states that the first release should not be labeled a thinking model despite the chat-template option.

sources.title: Apertus 1.5 70B model card: comparison with the first release
sources.evidence: The later model card says thinking mode and multimodal inputs are available for the first time in 1.5. Those additions and its larger context do not describe the 2509 checkpoint.

sources.title: Kolibri technical report, Table 28 and Appendix E.1 Table 48
sources.evidence: Table 28 (page 97) explicitly lists Apertus 70B Instruct with total parameters (B)=70 and active parameters (B)=70. Appendix E.1 Table 48 (page 159) maps that column to swiss-ai/Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509. This is Aleph Alpha's nominal comparison convention, not a separate Swiss AI disclosure or an exact per-token tensor count.

sources.title: Apertus 1.5 technical report: successor lineage and comparison counts
sources.evidence: The successor starts from Apertus 1.0 and adds multimodal training and a larger vocabulary/context. Its Table I.2 gives active counts for some MoE comparison models, leaves dense-model active cells blank, and has no Apertus row. It supplies no separate active count for the original 2509 checkpoint.

name.note: Names the exact instruction-tuned checkpoint linked by the frozen record; distinct from the base and later 1.5 releases.

developer.note: Swiss AI Initiative, developed through EPFL, ETH Zurich and CSCS; the catalog uses the abbreviated developer label.

family.note: The model card and technical report identify the Apertus model family.

release_date.note: The dated developer announcement explicitly says the models were released and downloadable that day; this is not inferred from an upload timestamp.

open_weights.note: The release distributes the model weights; the complete checkpoint index and tensor headers are accessible.

parameters_b.note: Retain 70,599,864,480 learned parameters (70.59986448B) at revision 0f2767662a013c0fb631079cea883155252bc3b6. The freshly reopened index explicitly reports this total; configuration and v4.56.0 module shapes independently reproduce it. Includes untied embedding/head matrices and 160 learned xIELU alpha scalars; excludes 160 beta/eps buffers. The earlier complete header census is retained without requesting shards again. The developer's nominal model size remains 70B.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 70B active parameters under Aleph Alpha's Kolibri Table 28 comparison convention. Table 48 identifies the exact Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509 checkpoint. This does not establish literal per-token participation or an embedding/component breakdown; it is distinct from the precise total and is not attributed to Swiss AI.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer with grouped-query attention, RMSNorm, rotary positions and xIELU; no routed experts.

context_window.note: Both the exact checkpoint card and max_position_embeddings specify 65,536 tokens.

modalities.note: The v1 report explicitly limits the models to text; image/audio support belongs to the later 1.5 release.

reasoning.note: Swiss AI explicitly advises against classifying the original Instruct checkpoints as thinking models; the template option is not sufficient evidence of that capability.

tool_call.note: The exact card explicitly supports tool use, and the technical report describes function-calling training data and tool-message formatting.

description.value: Instruction-tuned multilingual text model from the Swiss AI Initiative, using a dense decoder-only Transformer with xIELU activations. Pretrained on 15 trillion tokens; 65,536-token context, tool-use support and Apache-2.0 weights.
description.note: Replaces broad legal-compliance and language-support wording with directly documented architecture, training, context and distribution facts.

parameter_count_audit.method: Read each indexed safetensors file with two bounded 206 HTTP Range requests: bytes 0-7 for header length, then bytes 8 through 7+length. Match each tensor to its index entry and configured source-module shape; sum learned shapes only.
parameter_count_audit.source_version: Transformers v4.56.0, recommended by the checkpoint card

summary: Retained the verified 70.59986448B learned-parameter total after reopening the pinned index, configuration and implementation. Resolved active parameters to nominal 70B from Aleph Alpha's original Kolibri comparison, with exact 2509 checkpoint mapping. All 12 non-parameter assessments and the earlier header audit are preserved.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain precise total 70.59986448B; resolve nominal active parameters to 70B under the attributed comparison convention.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Reopened the original card and v1 report, pinned configuration/index and recommended Transformers implementation, then checked the newer original Apertus 1.5 report and Kolibri comparison. Successor counts were not transferred. Secondary provider/catalog estimates were not used as count evidence.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: No Swiss AI active-count definition or exact token-dependent participation count was found; the recorded active value is nominal.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: None for count evidence. Poppler emitted PDF dictionary warnings; both relevant rendered pages were inspected successfully.
